Ladakh Administration Boosts Pashmina Sector with New Initiatives

The Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh has approved significant initiatives aimed at strengthening the region's Pashmina sector. A key objective is to double the Pashmina goat population within the next three years. These measures are intended to enhance the overall Pashmina industry in Ladakh.
